idea-plugin.name: Log Console
idea-plugin.description:
Runs shell scripts (e.g. sh run-all.sh that starts stubs and apps) in a dedicated Log Console tool window with:
  • Error lines in red, warning lines in yellow, everything else in the default color
  • Stack trace lines keep the color of the log line that produced them
  • Live filtering by keyword or regex (include or exclude), and by level
  • Jump to next / previous error, multiple tabs, clean stop of the whole process group
Patterns and colors are configurable in Settings | Tools | Log Console.

action.description: Run this script in the Log Console tool window
